scope: Crossover map of state-saving (SAVE_DW/KEEP_PS) versus literature-adapted controls on assumed-cost SRAM-CIM; laptop-only; calibrated=false; no novelty or hardware claim

policy_notes.B6_loopindex: Not run: identical to B4_ci16 in this backend (tests_g9::test_b6_is_periodic_limit). Never counted twice.
policy_notes.B1_layer: Reported, but NOT a strong control (fixed contract, no preservation).
policy_notes.B4_ci16/B4_ci64: Both intervals are run as separate controls; no interval is selected, so no tuning.
policy_notes.B5a_inas: iNAS-style adaptation from public code; objective is nominal energy as a recharge-dominated stand-in for latency.
policy_notes.B5b_chime_dp: Chime-style DP adaptation; exponential-hazard planning model is an assumption.

grid.scale_semantics: Relative to the inherited G6 assumed NVM read/write energy; mapping to physical technologies is G9 stage 3 and does not change the grid.

planning_hazard_provenance: Fixed before results; deliberately not equal to the actual reset rate (policies do not know it). Not fitted.

inputs.kws: Per class, index 4..9 of the G8 'available' pool (hash-deduplicated, excluding all G5/G6 runtime use). G8 used indices 0..3. 72 inputs.
inputs.vww: The 20 G8 holdout images (no additional images exist). DISCLOSED REUSE: same images as G8 main; new reset/trace seeds and new policies. 4 G8 development images used for smoke only.
inputs.development_use: Smoke/fault checks only. No parameter is tuned on any split.

primary_endpoint: Energy per completed inference (model J), summed over the replicates of a cell, RECAP_redo versus each strong control, paired by scenario.

decision_rule.noninferiority: completion rate and on-time rate not worse than the control by more than 0.05 absolute (g5_experiments.comparison tolerances)
decision_rule.cell_win_vs_control: noninferior AND reduction >= delta_min AND bootstrap CI95 lower bound > 0 (undefined CI counts as not a win)
decision_rule.cell_loss_vs_control: control noninferior to RECAP AND reduction <= -delta_min AND bootstrap CI95 upper bound < 0
decision_rule.mechanism_check: RECAP_redo selected state-saving (a z=1 or ps=1 plan) for >= 10% of its tile decisions in the cell; otherwise the cell is 'win_without_state_saving' and is not counted toward a crossover region
decision_rule.region: Two grid cells of one workload that are neighbours (indices differ by exactly one step along exactly one axis) and are both cell_win with mechanism.

verdicts.REGION_BOTH_WORKLOADS: a region exists for kws and vww
verdicts.REGION_ONE_WORKLOAD: a region exists for exactly one workload; report as workload-specific only

decision_rule.primary_verdict_scope: cells whose nvm_energy_scale lies inside the grounded range declared in stage 3; full-grid verdict reported separately

grounded_range_rule: Must be set (with its sources) and the protocol re-locked BEFORE the main run. The main stage refuses to run while null. It selects which cells carry the primary verdict; it never changes the grid or the rule.

secondary_analyses.matched_hazard: RECAP_redo and B5b_chime_dp with planning_outage_rate_hz equal to the actual reset rate (oracle-informed upper bound; labelled, not part of the verdict).
secondary_analyses.stochastic_sources: G8-style synthetic source families at nvm_energy_scale 1.0, new test_seed_base 980000; reported only.
secondary_analyses.versus_B1: Reduction versus B1_layer reported, never used for the verdict.

reporting_obligations: Report every cell, including losses and ties, ordered by the grid; keep undefined ratios and infinite p95.
No parameter, seed, cell or rule may change after the lock; any change is a new protocol version with a new lock.
State that all costs and the planning hazard are assumptions and that results are model energy, not measurements.
State that B5a/B5b/B6 are adaptations (B5a from public code only) and that INTERCEPT/iNAS papers were not available.
